name: codeforces-assistant
description: Capture a whole Codeforces contest into one folder, run the samples in the editor, and have the submit form filled for you.

cfa.port.markdownDescription: Loopback port the browser extension talks to. Bound to `127.0.0.1` only.

cfa.autoStartServer.description: Start the capture server when this window opens.

cfa.contestsDir.markdownDescription: Folder that contest folders are created in. Empty means the first workspace folder. Supports `~`.

enumDescriptions: Open problem A after capturing a contest.
Open every captured problem in a tab.
Create the files but do not open anything.
cfa.openOnCapture.description: What to open after a capture.

cfa.templateFile.markdownDescription: Solution template. Empty means `~/.config/cfa/template.cpp`, which is seeded on first run. Use `$0` to mark where the cursor should land.

cfa.language.description: Language used for new files, local runs, and the Codeforces submit form.

cfa.python.compile.description: Compile command for Python. Empty means no compile step.

cfa.runTimeoutMs.description: Per-test wall clock limit for a local run, in milliseconds.

cfa.compileTimeoutMs.description: Limit for the compile step, in milliseconds.

cfa.handle.description: Your Codeforces handle. Used to poll the public API for verdicts. Left empty, it is learned from the browser extension.

cfa.verdict.pollIntervalMs.markdownDescription: How often to poll the Codeforces API after a submit. The API allows one call every 2 seconds, so values below `2000` are rejected.

cfa.verdict.timeoutMs.description: Give up waiting for a verdict after this many milliseconds. It has to outlast you reading the problem and pressing Submit in the browser.

cfa.saveSamplesNextToSolution.markdownDescription: Also write `<solution>.samples.json` beside each solution. Off keeps contest folders to source files only; samples always live in `<contest>/.cfa/contest.json`.

enumDescriptions: The line and column from cfa.cursorLine and cfa.cursorCharacter.
Where the template's $0 marker stood. Falls back to cfa.cursorAnchor when the template has no marker.
End of the first match of cfa.cursorAnchor, searched in the file itself.
Leave the cursor wherever VS Code puts it.
cfa.cursorOnOpen.markdownDescription: Where the cursor lands the first time a captured solution is opened in a session. Switching back to a tab you already visited never moves it.

cfa.cursorAnchor.markdownDescription: Regular expression the cursor is parked after, for `cursorOnOpen: anchor` and as the fallback for `template`. The default lands on the second of the three blank lines in `void solve() { ... }`.

cfa.cursorReveal.description: How the editor scrolls to the cursor position.

cfa.progress.enabled.markdownDescription: Colour the problem tab strip from Codeforces: green solved, red submitted but not accepted, grey untouched. Needs `cfa.handle`.

cfa.progress.pollIntervalMs.markdownDescription: How often the tab strip re-asks Codeforces. The API allows one call every 2 seconds, so lower values are rejected.

cfa.cursorLine.markdownDescription: Line the cursor lands on when a solution is opened, counted from `1` as the editor gutter counts. Used when `#cfa.cursorOnOpen#` is `position`.

cfa.cursorCharacter.markdownDescription: Shift along the line the cursor lands on, counted from `0`. Used when `#cfa.cursorOnOpen#` is `position`.
